name: cosmos3-super-reasoner
description: Cosmos3-Super reasoner-only lane (text→text). Exercises the AR backbone alone (32B Qwen3-VL 32B Instruct architecture) without engaging the DM generator or joint-attention runtime.
test_prompt: Describe what physical-AI reasoning means in one sentence.
skip: scaffold only — AR reasoner builder is wired (build_engine path) but B200 weight‐mapping + sanity‐check still pending; remove once nightly_only validation lands
notes: Reasoner-only manifest. Uses build_engine() rather than build_components() since the DM lane (Phase 4) and the C++ joint-attention runtime (Phase 6) are not yet implemented. The backbone shape is identical to Qwen3-VL 32B Instruct (hidden=5120, layers=64, GQA 64:8, head_dim=128, FFN=25600, mrope=[24,20,20], rope_theta=5e6, vocab=151936) — the AR reasoner builder delegates to families/qwen_vl/decoder_tp_builder.py.
